summary: inbox-v1 adds a provider drafts list and exact draft content so a client can open a Gmail draft and replace it through the existing reviewed draft-replace operation.

contract.list: GET /inbox-v1/drafts?grantId&pageToken -> {version:1, drafts:[{draftId,messageId,subject,to,snippet,updatedAt}], nextPageToken}; 25 per page, draft scope (compose/modify), metadata only (no body or attachment bytes), repeated or oversized cursors refused
contract.content: GET /inbox-v1/draft?grantId&draftId&content=1 -> {id,messageId,providerDigest,content:{to,cc,bcc,subject,bodyText,plainText,threaded,attachmentCount}}; providerDigest is the existing raw-MIME digest; the raw and full reads must name the same draft message id or 409 (one snapshot); threaded = In-Reply-To or References present; plainText false for HTML-only drafts
contract.capabilities: draftsList = draft scope; older servers omit it
contract.mutations: none; editing still uses the reviewed draft-replace kind with expectedDigest and acceptNonAtomicReplacement
